w.name: Vivid Notions
w.text: Provides 44.1% CRIT DMG, 28% ATK, and up to 68% Plunging Attack CRIT DMG at R1, making it Varesa’s signature and best-in-slot weapon.

w.name: Kagura's Verity
w.text: Provides 66.2% CRIT DMG and boosts Elemental Skill DMG and overall Elemental DMG, making it a strong 5-star alternative for Varesa.

w.name: The Widsith
w.text: Provides 55.1% CRIT DMG and a random ATK, Elemental DMG, or EM buff, offering strong but inconsistent damage boosts for Varesa.

w.name: Flowing Purity
w.text: Provides 55.1% CRIT DMG and a random ATK, Elemental DMG, or EM buff, offering strong but inconsistent damage boosts for Varesa.

a.text: Provides 27.6% ATK and up to 40% Elemental DMG Bonus at R5, making it a strong craftable F2P option for Varesa when paired with a healer.
Provides 15% DMG Bonus and 40% CRIT Rate while Varesa is in Nightsoul’s Blessing, making it her best-in-slot artifact set.

names: A Day Carved From Rising Winds
a.text: Provides 36% ATK, making it a solid 2-piece combination for boosting Varesa’s Plunging Attack damage.

t.name: Plunge & Punishment
t.text: Varesa drives Plunging Attack damage, Mavuika adds off-field Pyro and buffs, Iansan boosts ATK, and Chevreuse provides healing, ATK buffs, and Pyro/Electro RES shred.

t.name: Natlan CrossFit
t.text: Varesa drives Plunging Attack damage, Durin adds off-field Pyro, Iansan boosts ATK, and Chevreuse heals, buffs ATK, and shreds Pyro/Electro RES.

t.name: Air Traffic Control
t.text: Varesa drives Plunging Attack damage, Furina provides Hydro application and DMG buffs, Iansan boosts ATK, and Xianyun buffs Plunging Attacks and heals.

t.name: Bat Mobile
t.text: Varesa drives Plunging Attack damage, Mavuika provides off-field Pyro and buffs, Ororon adds Electro damage and Scroll buffs, and Chevreuse heals, boosts ATK, and shreds Pyro/Electro RES.

w.name: Fang of the Mountain King
w.text: Provides 11% CRIT Rate and boosts Elemental Skill and Burst DMG by up to 60% at R1, making it Kinich’s signature and best-in-slot weapon.

w.name: A Thousand Blazing Suns
w.text: Provides 11% CRIT Rate and, at R1, grants 28% ATK and 20% CRIT DMG, making it a strong 5-star alternative for Kinich.

w.name: Serpent Spine
w.text: Provides 27.6% CRIT Rate and up to 30% DMG Bonus at R1, making it a strong 4-star option for Kinich. Its stacks are reduced when he takes damage.

w.name: Earth Shaker
w.text: Provides 27.6% ATK and up to 32% Elemental Skill DMG at R5 after a Pyro reaction, making it a strong craftable F2P option for Kinich.

a.text: Provides 15% DMG Bonus and 40% CRIT Rate while Kinich consumes Nightsoul points, making it his best-in-slot artifact set.
Provides 18% ATK and up to 50% DMG Bonus while Burning enemies are present, making it a strong alternative for Kinich in Burning teams.
Provides 15% Dendro DMG and 20% Elemental Skill DMG, offering a flexible option for boosting Kinich’s Dendro and Skill damage.

t.name: Kinich Me Outside
t.text: Kinich drives on-field Burning damage, Emilie adds off-field Dendro damage, Nicole provides ATK buffs and shielding, and Durin supplies Pyro application, Dendro RES shred, and off-field damage.

t.name: Ajaw & Order
t.text: Kinich deals the damage and Bennett buffs the team.

t.name: Let Him Cook
t.text: Kinich drives Burning damage, Iansan boosts ATK and DMG, Bennett provides ATK buffs and healing, and Xiangling supplies off-field Pyro damage.

t.name: Free to Burn
t.text: Kinich drives Burning damage, Pyro Traveler provides off-field Pyro and buffs, Bennett boosts ATK and heals, and Iansan adds ATK buffs and DMG Bonus.

w.name: Disaster and Remorse
w.text: Provides 22.1% CRIT Rate and boosts Normal, Charged, Skill, and Burst DMG by 40% at R1. Its bonuses increase by 75% with Hexerei: Secret Rite, making it Lohen’s signature and best-in-slot weapon.

w.name: Staff of Homa
w.text: Provides 66.2% CRIT DMG, 20% HP, and an ATK bonus based on Max HP, making it a strong 5-star alternative for Lohen.

w.name: Deathmatch
w.text: Provides 36.8% CRIT Rate and up to 24% ATK at R1 against fewer than two enemies, making it a strong 4-star alternative for Lohen.

w.name: Missive Windspear
w.text: Provides 41.3% ATK and, at R5, grants 24% ATK and 96 EM after triggering an Elemental Reaction, making it a solid F2P option for Lohen.

w.name: Tamayuratei no Ohanashi
w.text: stacks granted on Skill use — the combo already casts Skill once every cycle.

names: A Day Carved From Rising Winds
a.text: Provides 18% ATK and up to 25% additional ATK plus 20% CRIT Rate after Witch’s Homework, making it Lohen’s best-in-slot artifact set.
Provides 15% Cryo DMG and up to 40% CRIT Rate against Cryo-affected or Frozen enemies, making it a situational alternative for Lohen in Freeze teams.
Provides 15% Normal and Charged Attack DMG and up to 36% CRIT Rate when HP changes, making it a situational option for Lohen if his team provides consistent HP fluctuations.

t.name: Witch Please
t.text: Lohen drives on-field Cryo damage and enables Forward Melt, Durin provides off-field Pyro and Melt damage, Nicole buffs the team and shields, and Citlali shreds Pyro RES and boosts damage.

t.name: Blizzard Queen
t.text: Lohen drives on-field Cryo damage, Furina provides Hydro application and DMG buffs, Citlali adds shielding and Cryo application, and Escoffier provides healing, Cryo RES shred, and off-field damage.

t.name: Amber Alerted Us
t.text: Lohen drives on-field Cryo damage, Vodyanitsa provides Hydro application, healing, and RES shred, Mona boosts damage with Omen, and Escoffier adds Cryo/Hydro RES shred and healing.

t.name: Lohen at Home
t.text: Lohen drives on-field Cryo damage and triggers Reverse Melt, Xiangling provides off-field Pyro, Bennett buffs ATK and heals, and Sucrose boosts EM and enables Hexerei synergy.

w.name: Reliquary of Truth
w.text: Provides 88.2% CRIT DMG, 8% CRIT Rate, 120 EM, and up to 36% additional CRIT DMG at R1, making it Nefer’s signature and best-in-slot weapon.

w.name: Nightweaver's Looking Glass
w.text: Provides 265 EM and boosts Lunar-Bloom DMG by 40% at R1, making it Nefer’s second-best weapon behind Reliquary of Truth.

w.name: Dawning Frost
w.text: Provides 55.1% CRIT DMG and up to 216 EM at R1 after hitting with Charged Attacks and Elemental Skills, making it a strong 4-star option for Nefer

w.name: Blackmarrow Lantern
w.text: Provides 221 EM and up to 24% Lunar-Bloom DMG at R5, making it Nefer’s best craftable F2P option.

a.text: Provides 80 EM and up to 30% CRIT Rate, while increasing teamwide Lunar Reaction DMG by 10%. Nefer’s best-in-slot set for Lunar-Bloom teams.
Provides 80 EM and up to 150 additional EM or 28% ATK, boosting Nefer’s Lunar-Bloom and reaction damage.
Provides 160 EM, boosting Nefer’s Lunar-Bloom damage and reaction scaling. A solid transitional option while farming her 4-piece set.

t.name: Petal to the Meta
t.text: Nefer drives Lunar-Bloom damage, Lauma provides major Lunar-Bloom buffs and Dendro RES shred, Nahida boosts EM, and Columbina supplies off-field Hydro and Lunar-Bloom buffs.

t.name: Petty Petals
t.text: Nefer drives Lunar-Bloom damage, Columbina provides Hydro application and Lunar buffs, Aino adds Hydro application and reaction buffs, and Nahida boosts EM and provides off-field Dendro damage.

t.name: Bloom With a View
t.text: Nefer drives Lunar-Bloom damage, Columbina provides Hydro and Lunar buffs, Lauma amplifies Lunar-Bloom, and Ineffa adds shielding, off-field damage, and extra reaction support.

t.name: Broke But Blooming
t.text: Nefer drives Lunar-Bloom damage, Aino provides Hydro application and Lunar buffs, Kirara supplies Dendro application and shielding, and Sucrose boosts EM.

why.v: Sustain: Optional depending on the team. Nefer's dash-heavy gameplay offers substantial protection, but a healer or shielder can make rotations more comfortable.. Lauma C1 makes Nefer teams much more comfortable.
